operators.name: custom_l1_loss_mean
semantics: Computes mean absolute difference between input and target tensors, equivalent to F.l1_loss(input, target) with default reduction='mean'.
Both input and target must be on the same CUDA device and have identical shape.
Supports non-contiguous tensors (strided) by using raw pointers and potentially contiguous copies if needed.
Returns a 0-dimensional torch.float32 tensor on the current CUDA stream.
Computes mean absolute difference between input and target: sum(|input - target|) / numel.
Default reduction='mean' yields scalar tensor of shape [].
